scope: Source-derived integer ordering witness and two constructed legal routing distributions; no native launch, latency, actual routing prevalence or GPU occupancy claim.

counter_guard_witness.interpretation: The existing counter no longer proves every first-M L1 N task was issued. This does not execute or prove a runtime deadlock.

same_shape_multiplicity.interpretation: Identical row counts/config do not determine expert-block reuse. Both are synthetic admissible examples, not measured workload mixtures.

necessary_eligibility: For expert e, b_e=ceil(n_e/BLOCK_M); multi-M reuse requires n_e>BLOCK_M. With unique per-token topk, n_e<=sum_r valid_rows_r.
known_workload_limit: Prompt lengths, output caps, shared prefixes and request concurrency do not supply per-layer physical routed counts, graph padding/AV mapping or active tactic.
